assumptions.statement_zh: 总体设计范围与三处重点区域几何由公开公告文字、约面积和空间线索推导，均为临时粗略边界，不是官方红线或法定地块边界。
assumptions.statement_en: The overall design boundary and three key-area geometries are rough provisional extents inferred from the public announcement, approximate areas, and spatial clues; they are not official redlines or statutory parcel boundaries.
assumptions.impact: Area calculations and location-specific proposals support concept development and package consistency only. All affected geometry and metrics require recalculation when official polygons are supplied.

assumptions.statement_zh: 法定用地性质、容积率、总建筑规模、建筑高度、建筑密度、建筑退线、道路红线、停车配建及公共服务设施控制条件尚未取得。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory land use, FAR, total floor area, building height, building density, setbacks, road redlines, parking requirements, and public-facility controls have not been provided.
assumptions.impact: The proposal states spatial and design principles but does not assign approval-grade numeric controls. These items remain unknown until confirmed by competent authorities.

assumptions.statement_zh: 市政管线与容量、消防、轨道站点工程、道路交通容量、河道蓝线、防洪、地质和结构条件尚未取得。
assumptions.statement_en: Utility routes and capacities, fire safety, station engineering, transport capacity, river blue lines, flood control, geotechnical, and structural conditions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Crossings, microgrids, building adaptation, proving grounds, and public-space structures are provisional concepts subject to transport, utility, flood, fire, structural, and environmental review.

assumptions.statement_zh: 文物清单、保护范围、建设控制地带、修缮分级和历史档案授权状态尚未完整取得。
assumptions.statement_en: The complete heritage inventory, protection boundaries, construction-control zones, conservation grades, and archive licensing status have not been provided.
assumptions.impact: Heritage proposals use a protect-first and verify-before-intervention approach; no inferred heritage line or repair method is presented as statutory.

assumptions.statement_zh: 地块权属、租赁关系、实施主体、项目资金和审批路径尚未完成尽职调查。
assumptions.statement_en: Parcel ownership, leases, delivery entities, project finance, and approval pathways have not completed due diligence.
assumptions.impact: Retain-renovate-redevelop and phasing proposals are methods and priorities rather than demolition, acquisition, funding, or delivery commitments.

assumptions.statement_zh: 公地理事会、年度活动、会员服务、收入再投入和AI场景运营主体为建议性机制，尚非政府或机构承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: The Commons Council, annual programme, membership services, revenue reinvestment, and AI scenario operators are proposed mechanisms, not government or institutional commitments.
assumptions.impact: Governance, operating, financial, and performance details require stakeholder agreement, legal setup, budgets, procurement, and annual review.
